ex.en: Our eyes take time to adjust to the darkness.
ex.zh: 我們的眼睛需要時間適應黑暗。

ex.en: I could not keep the tears from my eyes.
If only that lamp weren't shining in my eye.
ex.zh: 要是那盞燈不要照到我的眼睛就好了。

eye.en: one of the two parts of the body that you see with

eye.zh: have / keep an eye on：留意、照看

ex.en: I've had my eye on you for a while.
Could you keep an eye on my bag?
ex.zh: 可以幫我看一下包包嗎？

eye.en: to watch someone or something carefully

ex.en: Have you had your eyesight checked recently?
He lost his eyesight in the accident.
She raised one eyebrow and looked at me.
ex.zh: 她挑起一邊眉毛看著我。

ex.en: Sweat ran down from his eyebrow.
ex.zh: 汗水從他的眉毛流下來。

ex.en: I need to trim my eyebrows.
